# PaintMesh <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Meshes](Blitz3D-Meshes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PaintMesh:Void mesh:Int32, brush:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh` | In | Int32 | required | Mesh handle. |
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | Brush handle. |

## Description

Applies a brush to every surface of a mesh: color, texture, alpha, shininess, blend mode and effects in one go. Surfaces that were painted before are overwritten. Make one brush and paint many meshes with it rather than setting each property separately.
